# ibee_gpu_vm_volume_attachment (Resource)

Attaches an existing block volume to a VM through the VM's attach-volume operation. Destroy calls detach-volume; it does not delete the volume. Import using VM_ID/VOLUME_ID.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_gpu_vm_volume_attachment" "worker" {
  vm_id     = "VM_ID"
  volume_id = "VOLUME_ID"
  # The volume's billing_catalog, for example ibee_block_volume.data.billing_catalog.
  billing_catalog = jsonencode({ sku_id = "SKU_ID", sku_code = "BLOCKSTO-NVME" })
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `billing_catalog` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted | Billing catalog for block_storage (the volume's billing_catalog, ibee_block_volume.<name>.billing_catalog) as a JSON object, passed to the API unchanged; the API requires it and decides whether it is valid. Omitted values keep the recorded value. It is sent with create only: adding a value after an import only records it, and changing a recorded value replaces the resource. |
| `confirm_unmounted` | `bool` | Optional | Sent as confirm_unmounted with detach-volume on destroy. |
| `guest_device` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `id` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `mode` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted | single-writer or multi-writer. Omit to use the API's default. |
| `mount_instructions` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `vm_id` | `string` | Required |  |
| `volume_id` | `string` | Required |  |

## Import

Import an existing resource with the identifier shown. Review the imported plan before applying; creation-only settings and local deletion permissions cannot always be reconstructed from the API.

```shell
terraform import ibee_gpu_vm_volume_attachment.worker 'VM_ID/VOLUME_ID'
```
